kind: CRUD gap G3 (CRUD standard, owner scope of 5 Nov 2026): real-invoice payments and their reversals need a second staff person, and every reversal carries a reason. One additive migration; real invoicing stays closed until the owner opens it offline.
findingsNote: No GAP id is created or changed. This PR closes audit gap G3 in docs/revamp/crud/summary.md; the Conductor updates that record.
sensitive: yes: real money (the real invoicing module), a database migration and staff commands. No auth, session, tenant-scope, consent, token or cookie code changes. Nothing is installed anywhere by this PR; the migration is additive and the owner merges. The ADR-064 amendment (payments and reversals) is written by the Conductor.
ownerDecision: 5 Nov 2026: 'Two people for both'. Recording a real payment and reversing one both need a second staff member's approval, and every reversal carries a reason, the same rule as invoices and credit notes. The Conductor confirmed: the second person follows the existing second-approver control, and the one-person payment command works only when that control says a second person is not required.
changed: packages/db/customer-invoicing-real-migrations/0002_payment_approval_and_reversal.sql (new, additive): the proposal table also carries 'payment' and 'payment_reversal' (new nullable columns, new checks); a payment records the approved proposal it came from; table real_invoice_payment_reversal (append-only, one reversal per payment, reason in plain words of at least 10 characters, rewrite and delete refused, row security on, no runtime or auth access); a guard on payments and on reversals for every writer that requires an approved proposal of the right kind, invoice and payment whenever a second person is required; the command log accepts prepare_payment and prepare_payment_reversal; real_invoicing_paid, _position, _invoice_json, _emit, the payment guard, app.real_invoicing_staff_pending, _staff_view and _staff_command are replaced with the same signatures, so their grants stay.

packages/delivery/src/customer-invoicing-real-staff.ts: the staff command accepts prepare_payment and prepare_payment_reversal; approving a payment or a reversal is not treated as issuing a customer document, so the made-up-supplier guard does not block it (approving an invoice or a credit note is still blocked while supplier details are made up).

apps/web/app/operator/customer-real-invoicing.tsx: while a second person is required the payment form prepares the payment for approval; a Prepare Payment Reversal form; waiting payments and reversals appear in Waiting for approval with Approve and Reject; reversed payments stay in the list, marked, with the reason.
packages/auth/src/customer-invoicing-real.ts and apps/web/app/account/billing/real-invoices-section.tsx: customers see that a payment was reversed, never why.

tests: tests/integration/customer-invoicing-real.test.ts (new G3 test; the payment test and the credit-note test record payments through prepare and approve; migration history lists two files), tests/integration/ws-c-team-work.test.ts (the made-up-supplier guard), tests/operator/v3-real-invoicing-staff-ui.spec.ts and v3-real-invoicing-ui.spec.ts.
alsoChanged: packages/delivery/src/customer-invoicing-real-staff.ts: the position a command may carry is 1500 (500 payments, 500 credits and 500 reversals), up from 1000, the same fix the Codex review found for sample invoices.

apps/web/app/operator/customer-real-invoicing.tsx: approving a payment reversal asks once in a dialog that names the payment, amount, date and invoice, says it cannot be undone and focuses Keep Payment (the CRUD standard D-02 rule).
The staff pending read names the amount, date and invoice currency of the payment a waiting reversal is for, so the confirmation never depends on which invoice page is loaded (Codex P2).

The database position checks on proposals (credit, payment, payment reversal) all reach 1500; the credit check from the first file is found by what it says, dropped and put back under a name with the larger limit, additively (Codex P2).
preserved: Payments, credits and invoices stay append-only: a payment is never edited or deleted, and stays readable with its reversal.
Exact money: whole minor units as text; what is paid is derived, never stored; currencies are never added or converted.

Every existing command, guard, event kind and customer read behaves as before. Prepared payments run the same checks as before at preparation (amount, date, reference, position), and approval repeats them.
The real invoicing control is untouched and stays closed until the owner opens it offline; payments recorded before this change stay as they are.
Events carry ids, the number and a sequence only, never the amount, the date, the reference or the reason.

behaviour.oneApprover: A payment or reversal is prepared by one person and decided by another. The same person cannot approve it while a second person is required; the named finance approver, when the supplier details name one, is the only approver, as for invoices.
behaviour.directPayment: The one-person payment command is refused ('A payment needs a second person: prepare it for approval') while a second person is required. It works only when the owner has recorded that one person may do both.
behaviour.afterReversal: The reversed amount is owed again: paid goes down by it, outstanding goes up by it. A payment is reversed once, and one reversal of a payment can wait at a time.
behaviour.stale: Approval of a payment or reversal prepared against an older state of the invoice is refused ('prepare it again'), like a credit note.

deliberateTestChanges: The restricted-login table check also lists real_invoice_payment_reversal.
The staff UI spec bundles stylesheets as empty, because the dialog imports one.
The payment test and the credit-note test used the one-person payment command; they now prepare and approve (that is the decision).
The migration history test lists two applied files, each hash checked.
The customer payment list now carries reversed: false.
nextAction: Owner decisions on the remaining CRUD gaps: G8 to G12 in my area, in the order the Conductor sets.
